expected.title: Connected-graph expansion of arbitrary formal weighted double Hurwitz n-point functions from Orlov–Scherbin partition functions
expected.author: Boris Bychkov; Petr Dunin-Barkowski; Maxim Kazarian; Sergey Shadrin
expected.difficulty_reason: The final connected-graph selection is formal once the disconnected expectation is supplied, so it is not the difficulty evidence by itself. Sections2–3 construct the weight-dependent conjugated Heisenberg operators and evaluate their vacuum expectations in the infinite-matrix realization, producing the operator and edge weights used in Proposition3.6. Those new computations and formal-sector coefficient controls remain required after standard Fock-space foundations are allowed.
